name: practitioner-bio
title_zh: 采访完直接生成英德双语个人页的采集器
tagline_zh: 不用再手动整理采访稿、翻译、找头像。它边聊边存，自动产出英文和德文简介、肖像和链接，直接挂到你的个人展示页。
tagline_en: Turn a chat into a polished English & German bio, portrait, and links—ready for your profile page. No more manual.
desc_en: Interview a practitioner and save their English and German bio, portrait and profile links to the practitioners collection, shown at / and rendered on hackersandwizards.dev. Use for "create my bio", "practitioner bio", "my bio", "Biografie erstellen", "hilf mir eine Biografie zu erstellen", "add my profile links", "update my bio".
why_zh: 把采访和存档合成一步：对话中提取信息，自动双语输出，省掉二次整理。适合频繁更新个人资料的开发者。
why_en: Merges interviewing and archiving: extracts details during conversation, outputs bilingual bios automatically, saving you a.
limit_zh: 仅适用于 hackersandwizards 的 practitioners 集合格式，且需在指定仓库环境下运行。
limit_en: Only for the practitioners collection format in the hackersandwizards repo; no non-EN/DE languages, no styling, manual fixes needed beyond scope.
